## Scope

The audit examined a sample of 468 graded sets. Each set was read again by a second grader to assess consistency between the original and repeat grading. The review used the same graded material for both assessments. This approach provided a direct comparison of the first and second grades and identified the extent to which the grading outcomes were consistent across the sample.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 71.8 per cent of sets. This result provides the overall agreement measure for the audit sample. It should be considered alongside the individual results for each grader, which are provided in the attached spreadsheet. These results will be discussed with each grader privately. The discussions will support review of the findings and consideration of any grading issues identified through the audit.
